title: 日本ダービーの後に・ノイズ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide takes the Japanese Derby crown, but instead of feeling joy, she comes away with a sense of fear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her numerous calculations, Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin both have something that keeps defying her estimations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She tries to figure out what that "something" might be and concludes that she lacks what they possess—an iron will to succeed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Upon reaching this conclusion, she asks me to increase her training intensity so she won't lose at the Kikuka Sho.
